name: lenticular
title: Lenticular
description: A lenticular picture: views cut into interleaved strips under a barrier grid, flipping as the pointer moves or the phone tilts.
author: obtainer <https://github.com/obta1ner>
docs:
Installed `Lenticular` in `components/ui/`, plus the `render-loop` helper in `lib/` and `useReducedMotion` in `hooks/`. Render `<Lenticular images={["/a.png", "/b.png", "/c.png"]} aria-label="..." />` with views of the same size.

The canvases keep the images' pixel size and scale down to fit (`max-w-full`, `max-h-svh`); cap the height with `className="max-h-80"`. The barrier color is `--lenticular-grid` (black). On iPhone a "Tilt to play" button asks for motion permission.
